UGA.note: The login features belong to an IT service-desk ticketing tool, not an identity authentication service.
A platform aligned to ISO/IEC 20000 is a system built to a standard, not a national adoption.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT says NITA-U's IT Service Desk receives, tracks and resolves IT incidents for institutions using government digital platforms, now through its UG Support platform.
The Ministry of ICT describes NITA-U as its implementing agency that coordinates and provides technical support for government IT services and infrastructure.
The Ministry of ICT says NITA-U developed the UG Support service-desk platform over nearly a year and launched it on 5 March 2026, naming no contractor.

UGA.note: Nothing on a national standards body or its standards.
